ability.name: Dry Skin
ability.note: If the battle opponent is a Water-type Pokémon that does not have any other types, this Pokémon is not knocked out in battle.

wheel.name: Poison Jab
wheel.note: *The battle opponent becomes poisoned. If the battle opponent is a Fairy-type Pokémon that is not a Steel-type Pokémon, it is knocked out.

wheel.name: Cross Chop
wheel.note: Spin again - if Cross Chop is spun, it deals +50 damage.

wheel.name: Acid Breath
wheel.note: The battle opponent becomes poisoned. The battle opponent's [CTRL PID 371][Metal Coat] effects are lost and [CTRL PID 371][Metal Coat] counts as having been used. This does not cause it to return to its previous Evolution.
